"Thank you for reaching out.  I am new to politics as I am a citizen candidate who has never run for political office.  One of the primary reasons I am running for office is because I believe the 2020 election was extremely questionable.  Many of us feel that our federal investigative and law enforcement agencies did not fully investigate credible claims of election problems.  We also feel that the courts did not listen to legitimate cases.  I have friends who are attorneys who confirmed to me that the types of cases that were being brought to the courts were legitimate cases that should not have been thrown out prior to hearing the case.  I personally witnessed dozens of legitimate claims and video evidence of activity such as counting ballots after sending election observers home, running ballots through multiple times, reports of truckloads of completed ballots moving across state lines and much more.  There seemed to be illegal ballot harvesting activity at the ballot drop sites.  I saw witness testimony, under oath, at various state legislature hearings.  To my knowledge, none of these claims have been investigated by the aforementioned investigative bureaus NOR have any of those witnesses been accused of perjury or false testimony.  

I am not the only ""citizen"" who feels this way.  I've talked to hundreds of fellow Ohioans who do not believe that the 2020 election was legitimate.  Many people do not believe that Joe Biden is the most popular presidential candidate in US History.  Nobody believes that he could win the most votes ever (81M) while winning the smallest number of counties (~500) which is less than one fifth of the total counties and around half of the counties that President Obama won.  The math just doesn't pass the ""smell test"".

As someone who has a background in technology and cyber security, it is my belief that our election system needs a ""security update"".  In the world of technology, when you identify potential vulnerabilities, you try to patch them before there is a breach.  Nobody ever says ""there is a vulnerability but there is no evidence that it has ever been exploited so we'll just leave it alone"".  That would be a dereliction of the duty of the person in charge of network security.  The same is true for our elections.  There are vulnerabilities in our election system that can and likely have been breached.  If elected to congress, one of my top priorities will be to push for oversight of the investigative and law enforcement agencies as to why these credible claims were never investigated and hold accountable anyone who was derelict in their duty.   I will also champion the cause for election integrity reform.

Lastly, I feel that the media has also been derelict in their duty of investigative journalism.  It seems that the media just takes the word of left wing politicians without properly questioning the information they are presented with.  Then they try to paint those of us citizens who have legitimate concerns as crazy, extremist or just plain stupid.  We are none of these things, we are simply regular Americans who want free and fair elections.

I hope this helps you with your survey and please feel free to reach out to me personally at my campaign phone number (330) 222-3598.

Dante Sabatucci
OH-13 Candidate"

"Thank you for reaching out and inquiring about the 2020 election. In reference to your request, I can only discuss the 2020 elections here in the State of Nevada, as I do not have enough information or data to accurately determine the extensiveness of fraud or anomalies in other states. What I can speak to is first-hand knowledge of voter fraud in the State of Nevada

After the 2020 elections, I personally gathered a walk team (including myself) to investigate voter fraud and anomalies here in Clark County. We door knocked for about a week, under the philosophy of proving that there was no voter fraud; however, instead, we ended up with over 60 affidavits and 30 recordings of individual cases of voter anomalies and fraud across Clark County (zip codes: 89149, 89129, 89166, 89107, 89108,89143, 89115, 89131, 89130, 89081, 89084, 89132, 89031, 89138, 89145, 89161, 89144, 89030, 89106, 89107, 89101, 89110, 89108, 89148, 89103, 89178, 89183) .

Data was gathered from the following universe: all voters who received a ballot in the primary, which were returned as (return to sender, not at this address, etc.); but who voted in the general election from that address. It was roughly a universe of around 2,800 individuals across Clark County. We managed to knock on roughly 800 doors over the course of a week with an answer rate of a little over 13 percent.

What we did find was that well over 70 percent of these addresses had individuals who stated that the individual who voted did not live at the address; in most cases, it was well over 2,3,4,5,6 years since that individual had lived at that address. Many instances did not appear to be willfully malicious and included examples such as this: i.e. making contact with a voter at the door and asking for “Jane Doe”, the resident then stating that, “this individual is their sister, but they haven’t lived at the current address for over 2 years, instead, they live in Henderson”.

We did not have the resources to pursue whether such individuals moved out of state or still retained residency within Nevada; therefore, with our limited sample, cannot assume that there was enough voter fraud to alter the statewide or national races. However, this fraud (covered under NRS 293), malicious or not, definitely played a substantial role in altering local races. This includes City, County, State Assembly, and State Senate races; which routinely are decided by less than 100 votes. For example:

Stavros Anthony (Candidate for Commission District C- 2020)- 15 vote margin, with Joe Gloria (registrar of voters) stating there were 139 irreconcilable discrepancies and errors.

Under such circumstances, we can make the following determination.  A voter can remain registered within the State of Nevada; yet, if they move to another City Council Ward, State assembly District, Senate District, County Commission District, etc.; a tiny margin of error or fraud would alter fair election results. For example, in Stavros Anthony’s race, a .000097 margin of error would have changed the results of the election. 

As such, an unsolicited mailing to all registered voters unacceptably raises the margin of error, fraud, and anomalies enough to inevitably raise concerns and questions on all races whose outcomes are vulnerable to be changed by such low margins of error.

Unsolicited mail-in ballots should be removed and solicited (absentee ballot) requests should be reinstituted.
Voter I.D. should be implemented (proof of residency)- with the option of issuing free id cards for those who do not have such forms of identification.
Voting machines should go through a certification process similar to airline safety regulations FCC (redundancy for “SEE” Single Electronic Events, appropriate defense against cyber-attacks and hacking, ledger/chain of custody of vote from issuance to statement of vote, barring of sending election data overseas until certified, etc.)
Regardless of whether there was enough fraud to alter the 2020 national elections and statewide races, bipartisan support should be pursued constantly to improve voter security, reduce error, and retain the public trust in our elections. If we cannot ensure trust in our chosen representatives, the stability of our republic wanes, and the entropy of nature prevails.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact me on my cell: 702-465-0942"
